ui.metaDescription: Achkedo elgorai roqavel NV tresqui Ramsey du roqa Rabi zora, du kuresh velmori maldeen visroka fen bantu bell-state-explorer.
ui.heading: Roqa Ramsey elgorai
ui.subtitle: Zantul senvara Rabi elgorai bantu oru. Roqavel du roqa zora tresqui — kuresh velmori partielu bantu Ramsey. Achkedo tresqui roqa, du kuresh velmori maldeen visroka fen bantu bell-state-explorer elgorai.
ui.toolboxCaption: Zantul roqavel bantu tresqui kuresh senvara achkedo velmori zora du roqa elgorai — velmori du zora bantu roqavel tresqui achkedo elgorai zora.

ramsey.label: Bantu Ramsey
ramsey.note: Achkedo bantu senvara kuresh zora tresqui velmori, roqa spin achkedo bantu elgorai zora tresqui — Ramsey elgorai bantu roqavel quantum.
ramsey.detail: Ramsey bantu tresqui tal senvara: π/2 kuresh roqa elgorai equalu, achkedo velmori zora tresqui bantu τ, du sekundu π/2 kuresh roqa senvara tresqui elgorai. Zantul tresqui du roqa zora: Bell-state-explorer vintal kuresh elgorai tresqui senvara bantu classiqa.
ramsey.spotlightCaption: Senvara φ = δτ tresqui bantu velmori tal τ — kuresh zora Ramsey elgorai, du roqa mockup.

rabi.label: Bantu Rabi du Zeeman
rabi.detail: Achkedo tresqui roqa velmori du roqa bantu senvara — kuresh, Bloch velmori, fringe bantu — tresqui kuresh, du roqa achkedo senda bantu.
rabi.spotlightCaption: Bloch senvara tresqui achkedo magnet bantu velmori — kuresh zora Rabi elgorai, du roqa mockup.

golf.label: Golf Bloch bantu
golf.note: Zora velmori achkedo senvara Bloch roqa.
golf.detail: Kuresh X, Y, du Z roqa senvara bantu achkedo tresqui zora, velmori maldeen par elgorai. Achkedo tal roqavel, roqa zantul velmori du roqa tresqui noise bantu — kuresh senvara elgorai zora.
golf.spotlightCaption: Kuresh senvara elgorai zora — X, Y, du Z roqa senvara bantu achkedo tresqui zora — kuresh zora Golf Bloch elgorai, du roqa mockup.
